paper.title: Effect of Al Content on Inclusions in Fe-15Mn- Al-C Low-Density Steel
paper.paper_scope: Three laboratory smelting experiments of Fe-15Mn-xAl-C (x = 1, 3, 5) low-density steel with different Al contents were conducted to study the effect of Al content on the solidification route and on inclusion types, number and size distribution, and precipitation mechanism.

alloys.description: Fe-15Mn-1Al-C low-density steel produced by laboratory smelting with nominal Al content x = 1; the experimental steel was named 1# based on its measured Al content of 0.868%.
alloys.alloys_notes: Measured impurities (mass%): N 0.0032, P 0.043, S 0.014, O 0.0005. Si (~0.32%) and Ti (~57 ppm) are residuals from raw materials; Mn and C are intentional alloying elements in Fe-Mn-Al-C low-density steel.

source.reason: 论文开展三组 Fe-15Mn-xAl-C (x = 1, 3, 5) 低密度钢熔炼实验，其中名义 x = 1 的合金对应 1# 钢，实测 Al = 0.868%（Table 2），构成一个独立成分体系。

processes.process_name: Laboratory smelting at 1873 K with furnace cooling (as-cast)
processes.description: Iron powder (700 g) and ferrous oxalate (FeC2O4·H2O, 1.575 g) placed in an alumina crucible, heated in a tubular furnace to 1873 K and held for 40 min; then 225 g ferromanganese added and held for 20 min; then aluminum particles (11/28/48 g, wrapped in pure iron sheet) added and held for 60 min; finally cooled to room temperature in the tubular furnace.
processes.processes_notes: Shared smelting and furnace-cooling route for all three alloys; only the added mass of pure aluminum particles differs (11, 28, 48 g), which produces the three distinct alloy compositions. The final state is furnace-cooled (as-cast) solid steel.

source.reason: 三组实验采用一致的熔炼与冷却流程（1873 K 保温、加锰铁、加铝、炉冷），仅铝粒加入量不同，因此终态工艺身份只定义一条。
1# 样品是名义 x=1 的 Fe-15Mn-1Al-C 钢经 1873 K 熔炼炉冷后得到的试样，用于夹杂物形貌/类型/数量分析。
2# 样品是名义 x=3 的 Fe-15Mn-3Al-C 钢经相同熔炼炉冷工艺后的试样，用于夹杂物形貌/类型/数量分析。
3# 样品是名义 x=5 的 Fe-15Mn-5Al-C 钢经相同熔炼炉冷工艺后的试样，用于夹杂物形貌/类型/数量分析。

unmapped_findings: Inclusion types in the three samples are almost the same, mainly Al2O3, AlN, MnS, TiN, Al2O3-MnS, AlN-MnS, TiN-MnS, and Al2O3·AlN·MnS (b0003).
2D mismatch degrees: Al2O3/MnS 8.41%, AlN/MnS 8.94%, TiN/MnS 11.65%, AlN/Al2O3 11.66% (b0110, b0114).
